_what: Ten-Percent Days 3.0 v4 FORWARD TEST, version 2. Re-registered 2026-10-01 because the candidate universe changed: v1 scored the top 1,000 symbols by median turnover, which on 2026-09-30 set a real floor of Rs 4.67 cr -- 4.7x the Rs 1 cr the paper rules document -- and left 371 symbols clearing the documented bar permanently unscored. Measured consequence: of 136 distinct stocks that moved >5% between 28 Sep and 1 Oct 2026, 46 liquid ones were never candidates. v1 is VOID from this date: its 10 graded sessions were scored on a different universe and must not be pooled with v2's.
model: v4: MODEL_COLUMNS_V4 (84 inputs), HEADS_V4 = p_up10_1d, p_down10_1d, p_up5_1d, p_down5_1d; monthly retrain as v2/v3; results-print block from the evening NSE capture merged with stamped warehouse rows

forward_window._first_target_note: first NSE session on or after the re-lock; 2026-10-02 is Gandhi Jayanti. VERIFY against the NSE calendar before the first run.

snapshot_rules.requires: that evening's results capture file, hashed into the manifest

high_confidence.calibrated_if: mean predicted probability of rows >= threshold inside the Wilson 95% interval of their realised rate
high_confidence.may_be_shown_as_high_confidence_only_if: the head's high-confidence rule PASSES at the verdict; before that, >= 50% rows are logged, never labelled as confident
high_confidence.if_fewer_than_min_rows_at_verdict: INSUFFICIENT: no high-confidence label for that head

capture_health.measure: share of results filings broadcast in the print window that were captured and parsed that evening, checked against the next day's NSE listing
capture_health.if_below: the night's v4 snapshot is flagged capture_degraded and excluded from the high-confidence judgement (still graded for ranking/calibration)

serving: nothing served until the verdict; the page stays hidden (empty allowlist)

supersedes.why: universe definition changed; the samples are not comparable

universe.rule: median turnover over the prior 126 sessions >= Rs 1 crore AND >= 60 bars in that window
universe._why_no_cap: A top-N cap silently converts a liquidity rule into whatever rank N happens to be that day. The universe is now sized by its filters; max_symbols exists only as a runaway guard and is off.
universe._why_60_bars: 60 is what the scorer already requires (forward.WARMUP_BARS), set by the longest feature window in MODEL_COLUMNS_V4 -- ret60, with dist_sma50 and sma50_slope behind it. A universe gate stricter than the scorer drops symbols the model could handle; looser admits symbols whose features are undefined.
universe.known_exclusions: Recent listings below 60 bars stay out and CANNOT be admitted by tuning this rule -- their ret60 and sma50_slope are undefined. On 2026-09-30 that excluded MOLBIO (32 bars, Rs 213 cr median turnover), AUGMONT (22), VIVIANA (17). Covering them needs a short-history model, not a lower threshold.
universe.expected_size: ~1,400-1,500 symbols, varying daily with the filters rather than pinned
